name: Taylor Made Escapes
summary: Private skippered yacht charters and overnight yacht stays from Palm Beach Ferry Wharf on Pittwater, in Palm Beach, Sydney. Guests have a Beneteau Oceanis yacht to themselves, and the team can add platters, sparkling wine and a skippered sail. Michael and Lynda Ireland have owned and run the business since 2018.
standouts: Each charter and overnight stay is exclusive, with no other guests on board
Yachts are in survey with the Australian Maritime Safety Authority (AMSA) and carry a documented Safety Management System
Skippers listed on the site hold Coxswain Grade 1 NC certificates
Completed the Strive 4 Sustainability Scorecard through Ecotourism Australia, a pre-certification benchmarking tool

contact.address: Palm Beach Wharf, 1151 Barrenjoey Road, Palm Beach NSW 2108

trips.title: Skippered Yacht Charter
trips.summary: A private skippered sail for 1 to 6 guests on a Beneteau Oceanis yacht from Palm Beach Ferry Wharf. The yacht is booked for your group alone and you set the plan with the skipper, from sailing to a swim at a quiet beach or sunset in a bay. Trips go within Pittwater, Broken Bay and Lion Island depending on weather, and you can bring your own food and drink or order platters from the crew.
highlights: Yacht booked exclusively for your group
Itinerary set with your skipper, weather permitting
Skipper can show you how to sail, or do it for you
Snorkel gear and fishing rods on board (bring your own bait)

includes: Dedicated skipper and exclusive use of the yacht
Tea towels and beach towels

Plates, cups, crockery and acrylic wine and champagne glasses
Snorkel gear and fishing rods
Swim platform, ladder and cold rinse-off shower
Bathroom with toilet

SPF50 sunscreen
Safety and familiarisation induction on arrival

trips.requirements: For 1 to 6 guests. All guests must be able to move about a boat unassisted, and stepping into the tender and yacht needs some agility. No dark-soled shoes, stilettos or high heels. No pets (assistance pets are allowed) and no portable barbecues. Tell the team about food allergies or health conditions before the charter. Swimming is optional and getting back on board uses a ladder.
trips.checkNotes: Prices, durations and start times are shown only inside the Rezdy booking widget embedded on this page, which was not opened, so prices is empty and no duration is stated beyond the page's 'a few hours'. The overnight information page mentions 2.5, 3 or 4 hour skippered cruises as an add-on to a stay, but no day charter lengths are given. Boarding time is on the booking confirmation and guests arrive 15 minutes early. Booking links: the Rezdy catalog link found on the home page and in a 2023 blog post, plus the page that embeds the booking widget (carousel 463125). The home page card calls this 'Skippered day yacht charter' and the catalog is 'Skippered Day Charters'. A second page, /skipperedyachtcharters-1-10, is not in the menu but describes a larger yacht for 1 to 10 guests with a host and skipper (a September 2024 blog says 4 to 7 hours for it); it was left out as a separate trip because the live menu offers only the 1 to 6 guest charter. A person should confirm whether the larger yacht still runs. A 2023 blog adds that children are welcome with child-size life vests and that charters can pick up at Newport, Church Point and Careel Bay wharves; those are older posts and are not stated as facts here.

trips.title: Overnight Yacht Stay
trips.summary: An overnight stay on your own Beneteau Oceanis yacht, moored off Palm Beach near Snapperman Beach on Pittwater. A tender takes you out from Palm Beach Ferry Wharf and the crew gives a safety induction before leaving you on board. The yacht has self-contained cabins, a saloon, a kitchen with a gas stove, a fridge and a bathroom.
highlights: Exclusive use of the yacht overnight
Tender transfer from Palm Beach Ferry Wharf
Fishing rods, snorkel gear and a rowboat on board (bring your own bait)
A skippered sail, platters and sparkling wine can be added

trips.requirements: All guests must be able to move about a boat unassisted, and stepping into the tender and yacht needs some agility. The rowboat is only for guests who can row and swim, and a lifejacket must be worn when rowing alone or by everyone after sunset. The yacht must not be moved off its mooring. No 240V power on board. No pets (assistance pets are allowed) and no portable barbecues.
trips.checkNotes: Prices and availability are shown only in the Rezdy widgets embedded on this page (a calendar and a carousel, catalog 463124), which were not opened, so prices is empty. Check-in and check-out times and the number of guests are not stated on the current pages; an April 2025 blog post says an overnight stay takes up to 4 people, which is older and not stated here. The Terms and Conditions say no Taylor Made Escapes staff stay on board overnight. Fees differ between pages (call-out fee from the yacht is $150 on the Important information page and $100 in the Terms). There is no overnight metered parking at the Pittwater Park car parks; free street parking is on Barrenjoey Road and Palm Beach Road. Booking links: the Rezdy catalog link found on the home page, plus the page that embeds the booking widgets.

trips.title: Corporate Events
trips.summary: A day on Pittwater planned around your team, for up to 12 guests. Planning is done by phone with Lynda Ireland. The skippered charter information pages also describe group and corporate packages for up to 10 people, with catering available.
highlights: Planned by phone with Lynda Ireland
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only: the home page says to contact Lynda on 0428 485 347 to plan the day, so there is no booking link. Guest numbers differ: up to 12 on the home page, up to 10 for group and corporate packages on the skippered charter information page. That page links a Rezdy catalog called Packages (catalog 463119) behind the words 'go to our website'; it was not opened, so it is not recorded as a booking link. The only image on the home page card is a Facebook post graphic, so no photo is recorded for this trip. Departure point, duration and prices are not stated.

offers.text: Gift vouchers: Sail Away Gift Cards in $100, $200, $250, $300 and $1000, and e-gift vouchers for a nominated experience or package, emailed straight away. A customised printable voucher is available on request at no charge.
offers.conditions: Valid for three years from the date of issue, non-refundable, and cannot be cashed in or transferred (Terms and Conditions). If an experience costs more than the voucher value, the difference is paid at booking. Allow at least 2 working days for a customised voucher.

offers.text: Add a 90 minute skippered sail to an Overnight Stay, $250
offers.conditions: For guests staying overnight. Add it to the order after choosing a date, or contact the team; ask Lynda about a longer sail.

offers.text: Catering platters, each a generous meal for two guests: Seafood Platter $130, Cold Meats Platter $130, Cheese & Antipasto Platter $130, Vegetarian Platter $130, Breakfast Platter $75
offers.conditions: Order at least 2 days before the charter. Gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options are available on request and platters vary slightly with the season.

offers.text: Sparkling wine and champagne, chilled and on ice for your arrival: Jansz Premium Cuvee $70, Moet & Chandon Imperial Brut Champagne $120, Veuve Clicquot Brut Yellow Label Champagne $140, Bollinger Special Cuvee Champagne $160
Celebration cakes, $100 each: Strawberries and Cream Torte, Chocolate Mud Cake or Blackforest Cake, each serving 6 to 8 people. HOORAY! and XOXO banners are free to use on request.
Flowers delivered to the yacht before arrival: one dozen red roses $190, two dozen red roses $350, mixed bouquet $130

Other services listed with the extras: yacht transfer to The Basin and back, pick-up and return in mid Pittwater (Scotland Island, Salt Pan, Careel Bay, Mackerel Beach), pick-up and drop-off in south Pittwater (Newport, Church Point), and a skippered power boat for a photographer or a transfer to the beach and back
offers.conditions: No prices are shown. The Terms and Conditions say a fee applies for pick-up or drop-off at another wharf, and travel time to and from other wharves is outside the booked duration.

offers.text: Stay at Jonah's Whale Beach and sail with Taylor Made Escapes, with packages available through Jonah's or designed with the team. Guests can also fly in by seaplane and be met on landing.
offers.conditions: Costs apply and no prices are shown.

checkNotes: Prices, durations and start times for the two main experiences sit inside Rezdy booking widgets embedded on the skippered charter and overnight stay pages (Rezdy alias taylormadeescapespittwater). Those widgets were not opened, so no trip has prices. The only prices on the site's own pages are optional extras, platters and gift cards, recorded under offers. Trips: only the skippered charter and overnight stay are menu items; Corporate Events is a home page card sold by phone. A page /skipperedyachtcharters-1-10 (not in the menu, listed in the sitemap) describes a larger yacht for 1 to 10 guests and was left out pending a person's check. A Rezdy catalog called Packages (catalog 463119) is linked from both information pages and was not opened, so what it sells is unknown. /day-cruises-overnight-stays and /alltheextras2025 are older copies of current pages. Refund and fee rules disagree between the FAQ, the two Important information pages and the Terms and Conditions (refund for cancelling more than 14 days ahead, late-arrival fee, call-out fee), so no refund terms are stated in the trip summaries; a person should read all three before any cancellation wording is published. Phones: Lynda 0428 485 347 is used as the main number, Michael is 0418 424 546, and the information pages give 0418 371 042 as the number to call when running late. The site shows two emails, bookings@ (used) and hello@. The ABN in the page footer differs by one digit from the ABN in the Terms and Conditions. The 'Summer Special Offer' button on /links has no link or details, and the Set Sail in Autumn complimentary shiraz offer ended on 31 May 2025, so neither is listed. 27 pages were read, plus the sitemap and robots.txt. No captcha, bot check or block was met. The site's robots.txt names AI crawlers but its rules only restrict system paths (such as /config, /search and /api), and none of those were requested.
